customEvents
| where timestamp > ago(2d) and name == "ContainerLogDaemonSetHeartbeatEvent"
| extend
    ID = iff(isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.ID)), tostring(customDimensions.ID), tostring(customDimensions.AKS_RESOURCE_ID)),    
    Region = tostring(customDimensions.Region),
